front.name: Abyss Watchers
front.rules_text:
When ~ enters the battlefield, you get two souls. Place a fate counter on ~, then if it has 5 or more fate counters on it exile it.
                    If ~ would die, exile it instead, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.
                    Fate counters remain on ~ as it moves to any zone other than a player's hand or library.

back.name: Undead Legion
back.rules_text:
When ~ enters the battlefield, it deals damage equal to its power to target creature you control. Place a fate counter on ~, then if it has 5 or more fate counters on it exile it.
                    If ~ would die, exile it instead, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.

card.name: Alluring Skull
card.rules_text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to it's power to target attacking or blocking creature an opponent controls.

card.rules_text:
{T}: Add {B} or {U} to your mana pool
                  Morph {G}{G} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.)
                  When ~ is turned face up, Choose one -
                  Target player draws two cards.
                  Target player discards two cards.

card.name: Contrasted Cursed
card.rules_text:
Enchant player
                  Creatures enchanted player's opponents control lose shadow and can't have or gain shadow. (Creatures with shadow can block or be blocked only by creatures with shadow.)

card.name: Corrode
card.rules_text: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Remove up to two souls from that permanent's controller.

card.name: Creeping Corrosion
card.rules_text: Destroy all artifacts.
card.flavor_text: One day, all you see will become dust.

card.name: Crystal Lizard
card.rules_text: When ~ enters the battlefield return a creature you control to its owner's hand.
card.flavor_text: This deformed, unnatural creature must surely be the product of some serious misdeeds. Who created this monstrosity, and is it what they intended to make?

card.name: Duke's Dear Freja
card.rules_text:
Reach.
                  {B}{G}: ~ gains deathtouch until end of turn.
                  {1}{G}: Until end of turn whenever ~ deals damage to a creature, tap that creature. That creature doesn't untap during it's controllers untap step.

card.name: Ent
card.rules_text:
Morph {G} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.).
                  Whenever ~ is turned face up put two +1/+1 counters on it.

card.name: Estus
card.rules_text:
Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. You gain 2 life.
                  At the beginning of your upkeep you may pay {1}{G}. If you do, return ~ from your graveyard to your hand.

card.name: Expected Companions
card.rules_text: ~ can't be countered. When ~ enters the battlefield reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
card.flavor_text: I see, you've done this before.

card.name: Festering Goblin

(As long as a creature has a bleed counter on it that creature has  "At the beginning of each upkeep deal X damage to this creature where X is the number of bleed counters on it, then remove a bleed counter from it.")

card.rules_text:
Deathtouch
                  Whenever ~ deals damage to a creature destroy each equipment attached to that creature.
